items.text: Finding Nemo, Pixar Animation Studios' fifth feature film, was released in theaters on May 30, 2003.
items.question: Who did you see Finding Nemo with, and do you remember where you watched it?
items.source_quote: May 30 – Finding Nemo, Pixar Animation Studios' fifth feature film, is released in theaters, becoming the studio's biggest financial success up to that point.

items.text: American Idol contestant Clay Aiken's debut single "This Is the Night" debuted at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in 2003.
items.question: Where were you living when Clay Aiken's "This Is the Night" was on the radio, and who in your house was watching American Idol that year?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart that ranks the best-performing singles in the United States.
In 2003, there were 11 singles that topped the chart.
American Idol contestant Clay Aiken's debut single "This Is the Night" debuted at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, becoming the first single to do so since 1998.
